title: The second affine tensor unit is an epimorphism
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $A=f_*\mathcal O_U$, and $S$ restriction of scalars along $\mathcal O_X\to A$ on sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $T=f^*$ be the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $B$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $U$, $b:\mathcal O_U\to B$, and $\epsilon:B\to\mathcal O_U$. Suppose $P:\operatorname{Mod}(A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(B)$ and $H:\operatorname{Mod}(A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)$ are functors, $\kappa:P\operatorname{Res}_b\simeq ST$, and $h_G:H(G)=\mathcal O_U\otimes_{B,\epsilon}P(G)$ is an object equality for every $G$, using the sheafified tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Suppose $\gamma:ST\to H$ is natural and for every open $W\subseteq U$ and section $p\in P(G)(W)$, transporting $\gamma_G(\kappa_G(p))$ by $h_G$ gives the sheafification of $1\otimes p$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Then every $\gamma_G$ is an epimorphism: for any module sheaf $N$ and maps $q,r:H(G)\to N$, $\gamma_Gq=\gamma_Gr$ implies $q=r$. No affineness, quasi-coherence or splitting of $\epsilon$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01SB, morphisms-lemma-affine-equivalence-modules, construction of h and its tensor-unit map; Tag 008A sheafified extension of scalars

proof.text: Given maps q,r with gamma_G followed by q equal to gamma_G followed by r, precompose with the inverse object equality from h_G and apply the injective sheafification Hom equivalence. Thus equality reduces to the induced maps from the tensor presheaf.

At an arbitrary open W, use linearity and the tensor universal property: maps out of scalar extension are determined by their values on 1 tensor p for each p in P(G)(W). The formula for gamma composed with kappa identifies these values with evaluation of gamma_G followed by q or r. Use the hypothesized equality, cancel the two equality transports, and conclude. This is exactly the Lean proof using ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext and the sheafification Hom equivalence. Zero modules and empty spaces use the same universal properties.

theorem affine_module_tensor_extension_epi
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B)
    (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
    (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ U.Modules)
    (hobj : ∀ G, H.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))
    (γ : S ⋙ tensorPullback f ⟶ H)
    (hunit : ∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ)
        (p : (P.obj G).val.obj W),
      ((eqToHom (hobj G)).val.app W)
        ((γ.app G).val.app W ((κ.hom.app G).val.app W p)) =
        ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 U.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))).app W
            ((1 : U.sheaf.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W,(ε.hom.app W).hom] p)) :
    ∀ G, Epi (γ.app G)
